name: Baitarani

sink.name: Brahmani-Baitarani joint delta, Dhamra estuary near Chandbali
sink.location: Bhadrak district, Odisha, Bay of Bengal

did_you_know: At its source in Gonasika, the river emerges from a rock formation shaped like a cow's nostril and flows underground for about half a kilometre before resurfacing, giving it the name Guptaganga ('hidden Ganga').
For part of its upper course the Baitarani forms the boundary between Odisha and Jharkhand.
Together with the Brahmani, it forms a large joint delta at Dhamra that includes the Bhitarkanika mangrove and estuarine-crocodile sanctuary.
